title: Migrate Vape 4.21 GUI rendering to Blaze3D for Vulkan
objective: Build and validate a native Minecraft 26.2 GUI render-state backend using Blaze3D so Vape can render through OpenGL and Vulkan without issuing raw OpenGL calls on Vulkan.
acceptance_criteria: A 26.2 Fabric prototype registers a custom GUI render state and custom RenderPipeline through GuiGraphicsExtractor/GuiRenderState
The custom pipeline compiles and renders under the Minecraft 26.2 Vulkan backend on a Vulkan-capable CI runner
A small adapter can translate Vape's 32-float GUI batch payload into native vertex attributes plus per-shape GPU parameters
OpenGL backend remains unchanged and is covered by regression checks
Document unsupported effects and next migration layers instead of silently falling back to raw GL
